gap.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
gap.explain: Use the present simple after if.

gap.prompt: She said she ___ call me later.
gap.explain: Use would for reported future plans.

gap.prompt: This is the ___ film I have ever seen.
gap.explain: Use the superlative for more than two things.

gap.prompt: You ___ wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
The report ___ by the manager yesterday.
gap.explain: Use the passive for an action done to the report.

gap.prompt: I’m looking forward to ___ from you.

gap.explain: Use the past tense in reported questions.

mistake.sentence: She has finished her project last week.
mistake.explain: Use the past simple with last week.

mistake.sentence: I am living here since March.
He suggested to go to the cinema.
If I will see him, I will tell him.
mistake.explain: Use the present simple after if.

mistake.sentence: This book is more better than that one.
She told that she was tired.
mistake.explain: Use said that, or told me.

phrase.prompt: We need to ___ up with a new plan.
phrase.explain: Come up with means think of.

phrase.prompt: I can’t ___ up with this noise any longer.
phrase.explain: Put up with means accept something unpleasant.

phrase.prompt: She decided to ___ up smoking last year.
phrase.explain: Give up means stop doing something.

phrase.prompt: The meeting was ___ off because of the storm.
He wants to ___ for a new position at work.
I need to ___ an eye on my luggage.
phrase.explain: Keep an eye on means watch carefully.

formation.prompt: She showed great ___ during the difficult week. (STRONG)
formation.explain: Use the noun form of strong.

formation.prompt: It is ___ to check the weather before a trip. (USE)
He made a quick ___ to change the plan. (DECIDE)
formation.explain: Use the noun form of decide.
Use an adverb to describe how it works.

dictation.sentence: I have lived in this city for three years.
alternatives: I've lived in this city for three years.

dictation.sentence: She said she would send the report tomorrow.
The meeting was cancelled because of heavy rain.
We should leave early to avoid traffic.
He is looking for a job in logistics.
This is the most interesting course I have taken.
alternatives: This is the most interesting course I've taken.
